catalog.reason: A Catalog page lists what Marfa ships and explains nothing.

catalog/(types)/(core).reason: A type page holds the generated file for its type and one example item.

catalog/(types)/(system).reason: A type page holds the generated file for its type.

(reference).reason: A landing page for a tab holds a card for each destination.

(reference)/api-reference.reason: Lookup page: the overview and the error codes of the HTTP API.

(reference)/swift-sdk.reason: Lookup page: one part of the Swift SDK's calls and types.

(overview)/glossary.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the terms that the docs use, each defined once.

run/settings.mdx.reason: Lookup page: every setting an instance reads, each with its default.

(reference)/cli.mdx.reason: Lookup page: every command group of the CLI, around the generated command reference.

(reference)/folder-status-file.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the file the CLI keeps for other programs.

(reference)/typescript-sdk.mdx.reason: Lookup page: one client's calls and types.

(reference)/marfa-mcp-server.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the endpoints and tools an instance serves over MCP, and the rules a client meets.

(reference)/changelog.mdx.reason: An introduction and a component. The releases come from GitHub, not from the page.
